tagline.en_US: DOSBox Staging is a modern continuation of DOSBox a free and open-source emulator that enables the execution of MS-DOS software, especially video games.

description.en_US: DOSBox Staging is an open-source emulator that enables the execution of MS-DOS software and classic video games. It serves as a modern continuation of DOSBox, providing updated compatibility and performance enhancements for legacy applications. Users can interact with vintage DOS software directly in a browser session with support for audio, gamepads, and file transfers.
